incident-bot: Pager: HIGH — possible tenant isolation breach detected for customer-642 (VPC, dedicated pool dp-07). Routing anomaly flagged: requests for cust-642 observed hitting containers tagged for cust-499. Auto-isolation triggered. @oncall please ack. :rotating_light:

Mia Chen: Acked. I'm oncall for ENG-SRE. Triage starting. Which alerts did we get?

incident-bot: Alerts: `route_conflicts/tenant-mapping` (3 mins), `request_mismatch/high-err-rate` (2 mins), `kv-cache-miss-spike` (2 mins). Sample request hashes attached to alert.

Mia Chen: @Rajesh can you check runtime routing table (rbac/prefix maps) for dp-07? I want to know whether this is a control-plane config push or data-plane kernel level issue.

Rajesh Patel: Looking now. Quick note: dp-07 is a dedicated pool running on 8xA10G nodes in eu-west-1 with custom routing via our eBPF sidecars. Running `routemap inspect dp-07 --diff`...

Rajesh Patel: Output (snip):

```
+ prefix 10.72.128.0/20 -> tenant=642
- prefix 10.72.128.0/20 -> tenant=499
```

Rajesh Patel: Looks like a recent control-plane change flipped the prefix ownership. I can see a rollout at 2026-02-18T10:12:22Z from infra-cfg-service.

Derek Hsu: I saw a patch earlier to consolidate prefixes to reduce fragmentation. @Rajesh, can you pull the rollout id and diff? If it's an automated consolidation job, it might have incorrectly merged two customer prefixes.

Rajesh Patel: Rollout ID `cfg-rollout-20260218-1037`. Diff shows mapping collision resolution favored tenant-499 over 642. The change was authored by `infra/auto-prefix-optimizer` (job triggered by fragmentation alert).

Mia Chen: OK — impact assessment: customer-642 may have had traffic routed to 499's containers for a window. Check request logs for PII/exposed payloads. @Alice can you reach out to CS to prep customer comms?

Alice Ramos: On it. I'm opening a private channel with AE and legal. Quick ask — can we confirm whether any logs show payloads from 642 being processed by services owned by 499? If so we need exact timestamps and sample request ids.

Rajesh Patel: Running cross-tenant access query on the request-store. Query: `SELECT * FROM requests WHERE src_tenant=642 AND dest_container_tenant=499 AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-18T10:12:00Z' AND '2026-02-18T10:20:00Z' LIMIT 50;`

Rajesh Patel: Result: 8 requests matched. Payloads are primarily small text prompts (chat input). No large attachments. Attaching masked samples.

Derek Hsu: Confirming network-level path: the eBPF sidecar accepted routes from the consolidated map and programmed them. So this is control-plane misassignment, not kernel corruption. Good news: we can revert config.

Mia Chen: Immediate mitigation: 1) Rollback `cfg-rollout-20260218-1037` to restore prefix mapping. 2) Quarantine dp-07 from new routing until manual verification. 3) Create a temporary route filter for 642 to force routing to dedicated tenant pool. 4) Preserve forensic logs.

Rajesh Patel: Executing rollback now: `infra-cfg rollback cfg-rollout-20260218-1037 --force --reason "tenant mapping collision"`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback queued by Rajesh Patel. CI checks OK. Starting rollback to previous version.

Rajesh Patel: Rollback completed. Running `routemap inspect dp-07` again:

```
prefix 10.72.128.0/20 -> tenant=642
...other prefixes...
```

Rajesh Patel: Verified mapping restored. Doing a sanity-check: replaying sampled request ids through pathsim to ensure they route back to tenant-642 containers.

Mia Chen: Good. Next: we need to validate data exposure window (10:12:22Z — 10:18:40Z) and list all request ids and destinations, then hand off to forensics and legal. @Alice, can you collect those 8 samples and share to the private channel? Mask as required.

Alice Ramos: Shared masked payloads and a short summary in private. AE notified; legal will join. I'm drafting customer-facing note: will confirm exact window and mitigation actions, and offer log excerpts on request.

Derek Hsu: Postmortem actions for infra team: 1) add safety check to prefix-optimizer to avoid overriding explicit tenant tags. 2) add a dry-run that validates no collisions against active tenant allocations. 3) add a canary gate for consolidation jobs (apply to 1 pool first).

Mia Chen: Agreed. Also add a runtime monitor that alerts on unexpected cross-tenant request counts > 1 in a 5m window. That would have caught this sooner.

Rajesh Patel: Noted. I'm also adding a quick script to reconcile control-plane mappings with data-plane programming every minute for the next 24h for dp-07.

incident-bot: Timeline note appended: 10:12:22Z - rollout applied; 10:14:08Z - first cross-tenant request observed; 10:18:40Z - rollback complete; 10:20:05Z - mappings verified.

Mia Chen: Customer impact: small number of chat prompts (no attachments) may have been briefly processed by other tenant containers. No evidence of access to long-term storage or secrets. We will keep status as 'contained' but escalate to P1 for follow-up with legal.

Alice Ramos: Customer comms draft sent to AE + legal for review. Suggest we offer a 72-hour log export and a root-cause writeup.

Derek Hsu: For immediate mitigation we also isolated dp-07 from prefix-optimizer job (added to exclude list). I pushed `infra/blacklist dp-07 --job prefix-optimizer` to prevent accidental future application.

Rajesh Patel: I'm starting a dedicated audit job `mapping-audit --tenant 642 --pool dp-07 --since 2026-02-18T00:00Z` to ensure no earlier incidents.

Mia Chen: Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @Rajesh please take lead on audit and follow-on fixes. Derek, lead infra fix. Alice, keep customer updates. I'll monitor the until-handoff checks finish.

Rajesh Patel: Ack. Logging runbook steps: `runbook/tenant-isolation.md` step 3 (rollback), step 4 (forensics) executed. Will open an RFC for a safety-rule change.

support-bot: note: On-call handoff scheduled to next ENG-SRE oncall (Tom L.) at 11:00Z. Please post a short status update for handoff.

Mia Chen: Status for handoff: root cause = control-plane prefix consolidation incorrectly remapped 10.72.128.0/20 to tenant-499. Impact = 8 cross-tenant requests (masked), no large data exfiltration observed. Mitigation = rollback applied, dp-07 quarantined from optimizer, audit job running. Follow-ups = infra job safety checks, runtime monitor alert, legal/cs engagement.

Alice Ramos: Adding customer note: we proactively rolled back the configuration, rerouted traffic, captured masked request logs, and will provide a detailed timeline and remediation plan within 48 hours.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to 'resolved (mitigated)' — P1 follow-up required. Incident ID: INC-20260218-72.

Mia Chen: Thanks team. If nothing else, I'll leave the channel open for legal/AE questions. Tom please ping me if anything unexpected pops up during audit. :thumbsup:

Tom L.: Joining the channel. Taking over oncall. I'll check audit progress and follow up with a short summary in 2 hours.

Mia Chen: Handoff complete.
